name: relebo
description: Relebo from Claude Code: workflows, inbox and workspace knowledge through the Relebo engine.

engine_url.title: Engine URL
engine_url.description: Your Relebo engine address. Leave empty on a registered device — the machine identity in ~/.relebo/machine.json already carries it.

token.title: Session token
token.description: Only needed on devices without a registered Relebo machine; expires ~1h.

gate_mode.title: Gate mode
gate_mode.description: shadow (judge and report, never block) or enforce. Default: shadow.

rubric_context.title: Rubric context
rubric_context.description: index (one line per rule at start; the sections and facts each turn needs arrive with every prompt) or full (whole rubric + facts at session start). Default: index.
